act_name: Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act
description: Protects women from domestic violence including physical, emotional, verbal, sexual, and economic abuse
key_provisions: Right to reside in shared household; Protection orders from Magistrate; Monetary relief; Custody orders; Compensation orders

act_name: Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace Act
description: Prevents sexual harassment at workplace and provides redressal mechanism
key_provisions: Every org with 10+ employees must have Internal Complaints Committee; Written complaint within 3 months; Confidentiality during inquiry; Right to transfer or leave during inquiry

description: Prohibits giving or taking of dowry
key_provisions: Giving or taking dowry punishable with imprisonment; Demanding dowry is a non-bailable offence; Penalty of 5 years and fine of Rs 15000 or amount of dowry

description: Cruelty by husband or relatives of husband
key_provisions: Non-bailable and cognizable offence; Punishment up to 3 years and fine; Covers physical and mental cruelty
Following a woman repeatedly; Monitoring online activity; Punishment 3-5 years; Cognizable offence

act_name: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act
description: Protects children from sexual assault, harassment, and pornography
key_provisions: Gender-neutral protection; Mandatory reporting; Special courts; Child-friendly procedures; Burden of proof on accused

description: Care and protection of children in need and children in conflict with law
